If $x_1 \mathbf{a}_1 + x_2\mathbf{a}_2 + x_3\mathbf{a}_3 = \mathbf b,$ then what is $x_1+x_2+x_3?$" :question/worked-solution "Since $\mathbf{b}$ is a linear combination of vectors $\mathbf{a_1}, \,\mathbf{a_2}$ and $\mathbf{a_3}$ with coefficients $x_1,\, x_2$ and $x_3,$ respectively, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3} & =b \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ -1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ 3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 7\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}0 \\ {x}_{1} \\ 0\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} \\ 0 \\ -{x}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}{x}_{3} \\ 2{x}_{3} \\ 3{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 7\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{2}+{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{1}+2{x}_{3} \\ -{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 7\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=1 \\ {x}_{1}+2{x}_{3}=1 \\ -{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}=7\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

![](images/9b/9bf913744317fab321cf9f2e01da732853a52a4fd7948c65da596ae4706f6dce.svg)

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & -1 & 3 & 7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & -1 & 3 & 7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 4 & 8\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :=\frac{1}{4}{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{3}=1 \\ {x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=1 \\ {x}_{3}=2.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get $x_3 = 2.$ Substituting this into the second equation, we get

$$
x_2+(2) = 1 \quad\Rightarrow\quad x_2 = -1,
$$

and substituting $x_3=2$ into the first equation, we get

$$
x_1+2(2) = 1 \quad\Rightarrow\quad x_1 = -3.
$$

So the solution of the system is $x_1=-3, x_2=-1, x_3=2,$ which means

$$
-3 \mathbf{a_1}- \mathbf{a_2} +2 \mathbf{a_3}= \mathbf{b}.
$$

Consequently,

$$
x_1+x_2+x_3=-3-1+2=-2.
$$" :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id "question-80bf8c74-6292-5b04-9a45-fc39723fd232" :question/id #uuid "80bf8c74-6292-5b04-9a45-fc39723fd232" :question/math-academy-id "q-73923" :question/problem "Find $m$, if $5{a}_{1}+m{a}_{2}=0$ and 

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -2\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 3\end{aligned}].
$$" :question/worked-solution "Using the properties of addition/subtraction and scalar multiplication of vectors to isolate the $m$ term, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}5{a}_{1}+m{a}_{2} & =0 \\ 5[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -2\end{aligned}]+m[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\ m[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]-5[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\ m[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-30 \\ 10\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the first components, we get 

$$
-5m=-30\,⟹\,m=6.
$$

But then

$$
\begin{aligned}6[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 3\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-30 \\ 18\end{aligned}]\ne [\begin{aligned}-30 \\ 10\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

If $x_1 \mathbf{a}_1 + x_2\mathbf{a}_2 + x_3\mathbf{a}_3 = \mathbf b,$ then what is $x_1+x_2+x_3?$" :question/worked-solution "Since $\mathbf{b}$ is a linear combination of vectors $\mathbf{a_1}, \,\mathbf{a_2}$ and $\mathbf{a_3}$ with coefficients $x_1,\, x_2$ and $x_3,$ respectively, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3} & =b \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ -1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ 3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 7\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}0 \\ {x}_{1} \\ 0\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} \\ 0 \\ -{x}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}{x}_{3} \\ 2{x}_{3} \\ 3{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 7\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{2}+{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{1}+2{x}_{3} \\ -{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 7\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=1 \\ {x}_{1}+2{x}_{3}=1 \\ -{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}=7\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

![](images/4d/4d3cb5eb82dd012582c78fc2c1201c62f99779d92974aba2a61f5a6bce8b91b9.png)

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & -1 & 3 & 7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & -1 & 3 & 7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 4 & 8\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :=\frac{1}{4}{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{3}=1 \\ {x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=1 \\ {x}_{3}=2.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get $x_3 = 2.$ Substituting this into the second equation, we get

$$
x_2+(2) = 1 \quad\Rightarrow\quad x_2 = -1,
$$

and substituting $x_3=2$ into the first equation, we get

$$
x_1+2(2) = 1 \quad\Rightarrow\quad x_1 = -3.
$$

So the solution of the system is $x_1=-3, x_2=-1, x_3=2,$ which means

$$
-3 \mathbf{a_1}- \mathbf{a_2} +2 \mathbf{a_3}= \mathbf{b}.
$$

Consequently,

$$
x_1+x_2+x_3=-3-1+2=-2.
$$"} {:db/id 17592186049058} {:db/id 17592186050178} {:db/id 17592186120309 :question/id #uuid "6f395246-75c5-52ab-b275-6f768034cd27" :question/math-academy-id "q-34243"} {:db/id 17592186120349 $$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}=-3 \\ 5{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=4 \\ 3{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}=-4\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 5 & 1 & 4 \\ 3 & 2 & 0 & -4\end{aligned}]
$$

$$
